{'text': 'My preferred transcription tool on Mac, MacWhisper, gets another big update today with live meeting transcription, significantly improved speaker identification, deeper Apple Intelligence integration, and brand-new transcription models. Details below.', 'translation': '我在 Mac 上首選的轉錄工具 MacWhisper 今天再次迎來重大更新，新增即時會議轉錄功能、顯著提升的講者辨識能力、與 Apple Intelligence 更緊密的整合，以及全新的轉錄模型。以下是詳細內容。'}

{'text': 'MacWhisper gets even deeper Apple Intelligence integration', 'translation': 'MacWhisper 與 Apple Intelligence 整合更深'}

{'text': 'I’ve written many times before about my reliance on MacWhisper, especially for my podcast production workflow.', 'translation': '我過去曾多次撰文談及我對 MacWhisper 的依賴，特別是在我的播客製作流程中。'}

{'text': 'MacWhisper was one of the first AI-powered transcription tools built for Mac. It has steadily improved since its 2023 launch by independent developer Jordi Bruin, and it continues to expand support for new models, services, and workflows.', 'translation': 'MacWhisper 是首批為 Mac 而設的人工智能驅動轉錄工具之一。自 2023 年由獨立開發者 Jordi Bruin 推出以來，它一直不斷改進，並持續擴展對新模型、服務和工作流程的支援。'}

{'text': 'Those improvements have spanned automatic meeting recording and speaker identification, folder watching, system-wide dictation, local and cloud AI models, and integrations with services like Notion, Zapier, Obsidian, and n8n.', 'translation': '這些改進涵蓋自動會議錄音及講者辨識、監看資料夾、全系統聽寫、本地及雲端人工智能模型，以及與 Notion、Zapier、Obsidian 和 n8n 等服務的整合。'}

{'text': 'Today, MacWhisper is being updated to version 15.2, which introduces improved speaker identification powered by NVIDIA’s newly released Nemotron 3 diarization model.', 'translation': '今天，MacWhisper 更新至 15.2 版本，引入由 NVIDIA 全新發布的 Nemotron 3 講者辨識（diarization）模型所驅動的改良講者辨識功能。'}

{'text': 'Which brings us to another big feature in this update: live meeting transcription.', 'translation': '這也帶出了今次更新的另一項重大功能：即時會議轉錄。'}

{'text': 'This has sat at the top of MacWhisper’s public roadmap for a while, and now it’s finally here, letting users view, scroll back through, copy, or pipe live transcription while a meeting is still happening.', 'translation': '這項功能一直在 MacWhisper 公開路線圖上位居前列，如今終於正式推出，讓用戶可以在會議進行期間即時查看、回溯、複製或傳輸即時轉錄內容。'}

{'text': 'On the actual transcription model side, MacWhisper 15.2 adds Alibaba’s QWEN3-ASR transcription model, which supports 22 languages, along with deeper integration with Apple Intelligence, Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts on macOS 27.', 'translation': '說到實際的轉錄模型，MacWhisper 15.2 新增阿里巴巴的 QWEN3-ASR 轉錄模型，支援 22 種語言，同時與 macOS 27 上的 Apple Intelligence、Siri、Spotlight 及捷徑（Shortcuts）實現更緊密的整合。'}

{'text': 'Now, users on macOS — including those in the EU — can search transcripts system-wide, open them via Siri, extract text to Shortcuts, and reference the on-screen transcript in Siri or Apple Intelligence requests.', 'translation': '現在，運行 macOS 的用戶（包括歐盟地區）可以全系統搜尋轉錄內容、通過 Siri 開啟它們、將文字提取至捷徑（Shortcuts），以及在 Siri 或 Apple Intelligence 請求中參考當前畫面上的轉錄內容。'}

{'text': 'Finally, MacWhisper 15.2 adds folders and subfolders to help organize transcripts and meetings, with support for dragging existing transcript files into folders from the sidebar.', 'translation': '最後，MacWhisper 15.2 新增資料夾及子資料夾功能，方便整理轉錄內容和會議，並支援從側邊欄將現有的轉錄檔案拖入資料夾。'}

{'text': 'You can learn more about MacWhisper 15.2 right here.', 'translation': '如欲了解更多關於 MacWhisper 15.2 的資訊，請按此連結。'}
